<script id='d-js-dmapi'>
    window.SystemID = 'US_DIRECT_PRODUCTION';

    if (!window.dmAPI) {
        window.dmAPI = {
            registerExternalRuntimeComponent: function () {
            },
            getCurrentDeviceType: function () {
                return window._currentDevice;
            },
            runOnReady: (ns, fn) => {
                const safeFn = dmAPI.toSafeFn(fn);
                ns = ns || 'global_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 11);
                const eventName = 'afterAjax.' + ns;

                if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
                    $.DM.events.off(eventName).on(eventName, safeFn);
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        safeFn({
                            isAjax: false,
                        });
                    }, 0);
                } else {
                    window?.waitForDeferred?.('dmAjax', () => {
                        $.DM.events.off(eventName).on(eventName, safeFn);
                        safeFn({
                            isAjax: false,
                        });
                    });
                }
            },
            toSafeFn: (fn) => {
                if (fn?.safe) {
                    return fn;
                }
                const safeFn = function (...args) {
                    try {
                        return fn?.apply(null, args);
                    } catch (e) {
                        console.log('function failed ' + e.message);
                    }
                };
                safeFn.safe = true;
                return safeFn;
            }
        };
    }

    if (!window.requestIdleCallback) {
        window.requestIdleCallback = function (fn) {
            setTimeout(fn, 0);
        }
    }
</script>








<script id="d-js-load-css">
/**
 * There are a few <link> tags with CSS resource in them that are preloaded in the page
 * in each of those there is a "onload" handler which invokes the loadCSS callback
 * defined here.
 * We are monitoring 3 main CSS files - the runtime, the global and the page.
 * When each load we check to see if we can append them all in a batch. If threre
 * is no page css (which may happen on inner pages) then we do not wait for it
 */
(function () {
  let cssLinks = {};
  function loadCssLink(link) {
    link.onload = null;
    link.rel = "stylesheet";
    link.type = "text/css";
  }
  
    function checkCss() {
      const pageCssLink = document.querySelector("[id*='CssLink']");
      const widgetCssLink = document.querySelector("[id*='widgetCSS']");

        if (cssLinks && cssLinks.runtime && cssLinks.global && (!pageCssLink || cssLinks.page) && (!widgetCssLink || cssLinks.widget)) {
            const storedRuntimeCssLink = cssLinks.runtime;
            const storedPageCssLink = cssLinks.page;
            const storedGlobalCssLink = cssLinks.global;
            const storedWidgetCssLink = cssLinks.widget;

            storedGlobalCssLink.disabled = true;
            loadCssLink(storedGlobalCssLink);

            if (storedPageCssLink) {
                storedPageCssLink.disabled = true;
                loadCssLink(storedPageCssLink);
            }

            if(storedWidgetCssLink) {
                storedWidgetCssLink.disabled = true;
                loadCssLink(storedWidgetCssLink);
            }

            storedRuntimeCssLink.disabled = true;
            loadCssLink(storedRuntimeCssLink);

            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    storedRuntimeCssLink.disabled = false;
                    storedGlobalCssLink.disabled = false;
                    if (storedPageCssLink) {
                      storedPageCssLink.disabled = false;
                    }
                    if (storedWidgetCssLink) {
                      storedWidgetCssLink.disabled = false;
                    }
                    // (SUP-4179) Clear the accumulated cssLinks only when we're
                    // sure that the document has finished loading and the document 
                    // has been parsed.
                    if(document.readyState === 'interactive') {
                      cssLinks = null;
                    }
                }, 0);
            });
        }
    }
  

  function loadCSS(link) {
    try {
      var urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      var noCSS = !!urlParams.get("nocss");
      var cssTimeout = urlParams.get("cssTimeout") || 0;

      if (noCSS) {
        return;
      }
      if (link.href && link.href.includes("d-css-runtime")) {
        cssLinks.runtime = link;
        checkCss();
      } else if (link.id === "siteGlobalCss") {
        cssLinks.global = link;
        checkCss();
      } 
      
      else if (link.id && link.id.includes("CssLink")) {
        cssLinks.page = link;
        checkCss();
      } else if (link.id && link.id.includes("widgetCSS")) {
        cssLinks.widget = link;
        checkCss();
      }
      
      else {
        requestIdleCallback(function () {
          window.setTimeout(function () {
            loadCssLink(link);
          }, parseInt(cssTimeout, 10));
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      throw e
    }
  }
  window.loadCSS = window.loadCSS || loadCSS;
})();
</script>



<script data-role="deferred-init" type="text/javascript">
    /* usage: window.getDeferred(<deferred name>).resolve() or window.getDeferred(<deferred name>).promise.then(...)*/
    function Def() {
        this.promise = new Promise((function (a, b) {
            this.resolve = a, this.reject = b
        }).bind(this))
    }

    const defs = {};
    window.getDeferred = function (a) {
        return null == defs[a] && (defs[a] = new Def), defs[a]
    }
    window.waitForDeferred = function (b, a, c) {
        let d = window?.getDeferred?.(b);
        d
            ? d.promise.then(a)
            : c && ["complete", "interactive"].includes(document.readyState)
                ? setTimeout(a, 1)
                : c
                    ? document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", a)
                    : console.error(`Deferred  does not exist`);
    };
</script>

 <div class="titleLine display_None"><hr/></div>

 <div dmwrapped="true" id="dmFirstContainer" class="dmBody u_dmStyle_template_walvis-bay dm-home-page" themewaschanged="true"> <div id="allWrapper" class="allWrapper" data-auto="all-wrapper"><!-- navigation placeholders --> <div id="dm_content" class="dmContent" role="main"> <div dm:templateorder="170" class="dmHomeRespTmpl mainBorder dmRespRowsWrapper dmFullRowRespTmpl" id="1716942098"> <div class="u_1323425029 dmRespRow" style="text-align: center;" id="1323425029" data-anim-desktop="none"> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1542234389"> <div class="dmRespCol small-12 u_1854405617 medium-12 large-12" id="1854405617"> <div data-element-type="spacer" class="u_1940124690 dmSpacer" id="1940124690"></div> 
</div> 
</div> 
</div> 
 <div class="dmRespRow u_1856952287" id="1856952287" data-anim-extended="eyJkZXNrdG9wIjp7InRyaWdnZXIiOiJ2aWV3cG9ydCIsImFuaW1hdGlvbiI6Inpvb21JbiIsInJldmVyc2UiOmZhbHNlLCJpbnRlbnNpdHkiOjEsInZpZXdwb3J0VGhyZXNob2xkcyI6eyJ0b3AiOiI2NiUiLCJib3R0b20iOiIwJSJ9LCJkZWxheSI6MCwiZHVyYXRpb24iOjF9fQ=="> <div class="dmRespColsWrapper" id="1006506730"> <div class="dmRespCol small-12 u_1456959295 medium-12 large-12" id="1456959295"> <div class="u_1820156328 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1820156328" style="transition: none 0s ease 0s; text-align: left; display: block;"> <h4 class="size-24"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);" class="font-size-24">Walvis bay &amp; surroundings</span></h4> 
</div> 
 <div class="u_1236565033 dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1236565033" style="transition: none 0s ease 0s; text-align: left; display: block;"><p class="m-size-14 size-18"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Where the towering dunes of the Namib Desert meet the Atlantic,</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Walvis Bay</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">stands as one of the most surreal kiteboarding destinations on the planet. This isn't just a kite spot; it&rsquo;s a vibrant coastal ecosystem where you&rsquo;ll share the water with an incredible cast of wild characters.</span></span></p><p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p> <h3 class="m-size-19 size-24"><strong class="font-size-24 m-font-size-19" style="font-weight: bold; display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Wild side of the Lagoon</strong></h3> 
<p class="m-size-14 size-18"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Walvis Bay is a sanctuary of raw nature. As you glide across the water, you&rsquo;ll be surrounded!</span></p><p><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="m-size-14 size-18"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">by:</span></p> <ul class="defaultList bullet"><li class="m-size-14 size-18" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Birdlife:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Thousands of</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Greater and Lesser Flamingos</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">paint the lagoon pink, while</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Great White Pelicans</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">often glide just feet above your kite lines.</span></span></li><li class="m-size-14 size-18" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Marine Giants:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">DURING THE KITEBOARDING CAMP,</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Humpback and Southern Right Whales</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">migrate past the bay AND THE DOWNWINDER ROUTE.</span></span></li><li class="m-size-14 size-18" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Locals:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">A colony of over</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">60,000 Cape Fur Seals</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">lives at Pelican Point. They are incredibly curious and will often &quot;porpoise&quot; alongside your board.</span></span></li><li class="m-size-14 size-18" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Desert Hunters:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Keep an eye on the shoreline for</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Black-backed Jackals</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">prowling the water&rsquo;s edge in search of food&mdash;a sight found nowhere else in the world.</span></span></li></ul> 
<p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p> <h3 class="m-size-19 size-24"><strong class="m-font-size-19 font-size-24" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">The Ride: Freestyle &amp; Downwinders</strong></h3> 
<p class="m-size-14 size-18"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The lagoon is a world-class playground, famous for hosting international speed record attempts.</span></p> <ul class="defaultList bullet"><li class="m-size-14 size-18" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Freestyle Flat:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The main lagoon offers waist-deep, butter-flat water perfect for unhooking or perfecting your carves. One tack away lies the famous</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&quot;Speed Strip&quot;</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">, a 2.5km stretch of offshore wind and mirror-flat water.</span></li><li class="m-size-14 size-18" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Downwinders:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">We offer 2&ndash;3 signature runs, including the legendary</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Pelican Point Downwinder</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">, where you ride from the lighthouse back to the lagoon, passing the seal colony and shipwrecks along the way. AS ALSO THE FAMOUS SKELETON WAVE BARREL.</span></li></ul> 
<p><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></p> <h3 class="m-size-19 size-24"><strong class="m-font-size-19 font-size-24" style="font-weight: bold; display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Budget Camp: Accessible Excellence</strong></h3> 
<p class="m-size-14 size-18"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">We believe the world&rsquo;s best wind shouldn&rsquo;t be restricted to the elite. Our camp is designed to be high-quality yet</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">budget-friendly</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">, making this bucket-list destination accessible to everyone.</span></p> <ul class="defaultList bullet"><li class="m-size-14 size-18" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Beautiful Accommodation:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Stay in our cozy, eco-friendly lodge right AT the</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Lagoon&rsquo;s edge</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">. Wake up to the sound of flamingos and JUST A WALK AWAY FROM THE LAGOON. TRANSFER TO LOCAL KITEBOARDING CLUB, STORAGE, AND DIFFERENT SPOTS WILL BE VISITED WITH 4WD.</span></li><li class="m-size-14 size-18" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Pro Guiding &amp; Transfers:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Forget the stress of 4x4 rentals. We handle all</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">airport transfers</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">and provide</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">pro guiding</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">to ensure you&rsquo;re always at the best spot for the tide and wind.</span></span></li><li class="m-size-14 size-18" style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Lessons &amp; Gear:</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Whether you&rsquo;re a total beginner or an advanced rider looking to nail your first kiteloop, we offer</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">certified lessons</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">. Full premium</span> 
</span><strong class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">rentals</strong><span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span class="m-font-size-14 font-size-18" style="display: initial; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">are available for those traveling light.</span></span></li></ul> 
 <h2 style="line-height: 1.5;"><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h2>

 <div class="dmNewParagraph" data-element-type="paragraph" data-version="5" id="1775570644" style="transition: opacity 1s ease-in-out;"> <h2><strong style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Adventure Awaits: What&rsquo;s Included</strong></h2> 
 <h2><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></h2> 
<p><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Get ready for an epic Namibian kiteboarding experience. We&rsquo;ve handled the logistics so you can focus on the wind. Your booking includes:</span></p> <ul class="defaultList bullet"><li style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Seamless Logistics:</strong><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">All airport transfers and transport between Windhoek and Walvis Bay (including secure kitebag storage).</span></span></li><li style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Premium Guiding &amp; Spots:</strong><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Expert guiding to a variety of world-class lagoons and secret spots.</span></span></li><li style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Ultimate Downwinder Support:</strong><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">* Dedicated</span> 
</span><strong style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">4x4 vehicle support</strong><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">for all downwinders.</span></span></li><li class="ql-indent-1" style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Professional</span> 
</span><strong style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">on-water and beach assistance</strong><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">to keep you safe and riding hard.</span></span></li><li style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Comfortable Stays:</strong><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Accommodation on a sharing basis (with</span> 
</span><strong style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">single room upgrades</strong><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">available).</span></span></li><li style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Total Flexibility:</strong><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Choose between our standard package or a</span> 
</span><strong style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">self-catering option</strong><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">to suit your style.</span></span></li><li style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Extended Support:</strong><span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"> <span style="display: initial; color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">Assistance with additional accommodation and transfers in Windhoek if your journey requires it.</span></span></li><li><span style="display: initial;"><br/></span></li></ul>
